import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=data)
plt.title('Transaction Type Distribution')

plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
sns.histplot(data['amount'], kde=True)
plt.title('Amount Distribution')

plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', data=data, order=data['hour_of_day'].sort_values().unique())
plt.title('Transactions by Hour of Day')

plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
sns.scatterplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type', data=data)
plt.title('Amount vs Hour of Day by Transaction Type')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
